BATCH.core_objective: Review and approve employee payroll items and leave applications, verify related tax or insurance details, and document processing decisions.

RESIDENT.core_objective: Review, update, and document employee resident-tax cases and processing details.

INV.core_objective: Validate and approve supplier invoices while recording processing or confirmation details.

SOCIAL.core_objective: Maintain employee social-insurance cases, including period-specific status updates and processing details.

PAYROLL.core_objective: Review and approve employee travel-expense reimbursements recorded as payroll items and document the decisions.
